FN-16WUZZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 159
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 159 as introduced would reduce sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
estimated $10.5 million annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 and each year thereafter, by
exempting the gross proceeds of the sale of certain baby supplies, baby formula, maternity
clothing, and menstrual hygiene products from state sales and use tax.
